idea.title: Faceless AI-generated history YouTube channel (AdSense)

source.text: A faceless YouTube channel that posts AI-generated history videos and earns from AdSense. Launch country US, budget $500, 10 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions.

idea.customer: US YouTube viewers of long-form history videos (paid indirectly by advertisers)
idea.solution: Faceless channel posting AI-generated history videos
assumptions: Channel starts in 2026-11 and cannot reach 4,000 watch hours before 2027-01-31, so the 8,000 h bar applies
Long-form videos (8-20 min), about 1 per week at 10 h/week
Opportunity cost of time valued at $15/h
RPM $6 per 1,000 views (midpoint of a vendor range)
unknowns: user skills in scripting, narration and editing

confidence.note: Many RPM and income figures come from vendor blogs; real YouTube Studio RPM data for new history channels would raise it.

gross_margin.note: R5 costs_eat_margin: ~$20 of AI tools per video vs ~$6 ad revenue at 1,000 lifetime views (estimate).

ltv_cac.note: ~$6 revenue per video vs ~$140 all-in cost; only 30.77% of 52-video/year channels even reach 1,000 subs.

pricing_power.note: Advertisers set RPM ($4-9 history, vendor estimate); a new channel has zero pricing power.

build_effort.note: First video can ship in under a week with AI tools; Veo 3 Fast is free inside Shorts.

skills_match.note: No stated scripting/editing skill; passing the reused-content review needs real human input.

capital_needed.note: $500 covers ~6 months of tools at ~$82/month (ElevenLabs Creator $22).

time_to_mvp.note: A first upload is days away; a monetizable channel is not (estimate).

sales_cycle.note: No ad dollar until 1,000 subs + 8,000 watch hours (new rule from 2027-02-01): 12+ months.

channel_readiness.note: YouTube is the channel but the user has no audience; 59% of channels never pass 1,000 subs.

search_demand.note: History is mass-market on YouTube; AI sleep-history videos draw large bedtime audiences.

trend.note: No 5-year trend data pulled; viewing looks stable, supply is exploding (estimate).

willingness_to_pay.note: Viewers pay nothing; creator gets 55% of net ad revenue, and only inside YPP.

free_alternatives.note: Unlimited free history content, incl. OverSimplified (~10M subs). R1 cap already met.

competitor_density.note: About 39,879 history channels plus an AI sleep-history wave. R3 cap already met.

differentiation.note: No edge stated; AI narration is the commodity the wave already uses.

legal_regulatory.note: Must label realistic AI content; prompt-only output is not copyrightable, so no IP moat.

platform_dependency.note: One platform; inauthentic-content policy (2025-07) can demonetize the exact format.

market_risk.note: Automated enforcement terminated 130,000 templated AI channels; rules keep tightening.

skills.note: No stated video, scripting or history skills (user input).

assets.note: No audience, data or network (user: no special edge).

interest.note: Stated goal is side income, no stated history passion.

tam.reasoning: YouTube ads + subscriptions revenue, full year 2025

sam.reasoning: Estimated yearly revenue of the 278 AI-only channels among trending channels (Kapwing)

som.reasoning: Base case: channel not in YPP within 12 months (30.77% reach 1,000 subs with 52 videos/yr; 8,000 h bar from 2027-02). Optimistic ceiling ~$1,440

competitor_price_range.reasoning: All competing history videos are free to watch; revenue comes from ads

demand_trend.reasoning: No Google Trends 5-year data pulled; 404 Media reports big bedtime audiences for AI history; supply rising faster than demand

price.reasoning: 1,000 lifetime views per small-channel video x $6 RPM (midpoint of $4-9 vendor range, fluxnote)

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: ~$82/month tools (ElevenLabs $22 + LLM $20 + images/video ~$30 + editor ~$10) / ~4 videos a month

gross_margin_pct.reasoning: (6 - 20) / 6 = -233%: tools cost more than a typical video earns

expected_lifetime.reasoning: Assumed lifetime views for a video on a sub-1,000-subscriber channel; no source found

cac.reasoning: 8 h scripting/editing per video x $15/h opportunity cost + $20 tools

ltv.reasoning: 1,000 views x $6 RPM, and only after YPP approval

payback_months.reasoning: Monthly gross profit per video is negative at base views, so CAC is never paid back

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: ElevenLabs Creator $22 (magichour) + ChatGPT-class LLM $20 + image/video gen ~$30 + editor ~$10

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: $82 tools / $6 per 1,000 views = 13,667 monetized views a month, time unpaid

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 6-12 months typical under the 4,000 h bar (fluxnote); the 8,000 h bar from 2027-02-01 pushes it to 12+ months

verdict.launch_reason: User's choice; US has the highest ad rates for English-language history content.
verdict.cheapest_test: Pitch AI-assisted script or edit samples to 30 US history channels in 7 days; stop unless 3 reply and 1 pays.
kill_criteria: Fewer than 3 replies from 30 pitches by day 7 -> stop
No paid trial by day 14 -> stop
If you run the channel anyway: under 1,000 total views on the first 8 videos by day 60 -> stop

rescue.change: Sell AI-assisted scripts or edits to established US history channels (50k-500k subs) instead of running your own channel.
rescue.why: Fixes sales_cycle, ltv_cac and platform_dependency: paid per video in weeks, no YPP gate, rides their audience.
rescue.effort: 2 weeks to first pitch; months to steady clients
rescue.requires: A portfolio of 2-3 sample edits and scripting or editing skill you may need to learn; freelance rates not researched

rescue.change: Keep the channel but make it human-led: one deeply researched niche (e.g. one US era), your own voice, AI only for visuals.
rescue.why: Eases legal_platform_risk and differentiation (inauthentic-content risk), but the 8,000 h gate and the wave remain.
rescue.requires: Narration, research and scripting skill; patience with $0 revenue for a year

narrative.answer: NO-GO. A new AI history channel earns **$0** until it clears 1,000 subscribers and **8,000 watch hours**, in a niche flooded by AI sleep-history channels that YouTube is demonetizing. With 10 hours a week and no edge, year-one income is likely zero.
tldr: Revenue is gated: no ads until 1,000 subs + **8,000 watch hours** (from 2027-02-01).
YouTube's **inauthentic content** rule targets exactly mass-produced AI videos.
Dozens of AI sleep-history channels already post daily; you would post weekly with **no edge**.
narrative.lesson: On an ad-funded platform, the **monetization gate** and the rules decide income, not the cost of the tools.

key_findings.title: 8,000 watch hours before the first dollar
key_findings.detail: From **2027-02-01** new channels need 1,000 subs and **8,000 watch hours**; only 30.77% of channels posting 52+ videos a year even reach 1,000 subs.

key_findings.title: YouTube is demonetizing this exact format
key_findings.detail: The **inauthentic content** rule (2025-07) targets mass-produced AI videos; automated enforcement terminated **130,000** templated channels.

key_findings.title: The AI sleep-history niche is already flooded
key_findings.detail: 404 Media names a network of look-alike AI **boring-history** channels; Kapwing counts **278** AI-only channels among trending ones.

narrative.recommendation: Do not launch the channel. This week, pitch AI-assisted history scripts or edits to 30 established US history channels and stop unless 1 pays.
narrative.steelman: History is evergreen, long videos carry mid-roll ads, AI tools cost ~**$22/month** for voice, and AI-only channels earn ~**$117M/year** (Kapwing). But those winners entered before the 2025 crackdown and the 2027 doubling of the YPP bar.

premortem.cause: Channel never reaches 1,000 subs and 8,000 watch hours in 12 months, so AdSense pays $0.
premortem.early_signal: First 8 videos average under 100 views each after 30 days

premortem.cause: Buried by daily multi-hour AI sleep-history uploads; a weekly channel gets no browse traffic.
premortem.early_signal: Browse + suggested traffic under 20% of views by day 30

premortem.cause: YPP review rejects the channel as inauthentic or reused content after the threshold is reached.
premortem.early_signal: Any upload gets an auto-applied altered-content label or a policy notice in the first 30 days

changes.what: YouTube renamed repetitious content to inauthentic content, targeting mass-produced AI videos.
Free Veo 3 Fast video generation launched in YouTube Shorts, so anyone can make AI video.
Kapwing found 278 AI-only channels among trending channels, about $117M a year in revenue.
Automated enforcement terminated about 130,000 templated AI slop channels.
YPP bar doubles to 8,000 watch hours for new applicants from 2027-02-01.

why_now.note: Cheap AI tools opened the door in 2024-25; the crackdown and the doubled bar are now closing it for new entrants.

icp.who: US adults who play long history videos as background or bedtime audio on YouTube
icp.pays_for_today: Nothing: they watch free YouTube history videos; advertisers pay creators 55% of net ad revenue
icp.trigger: Bedtime or a long commute, looking for a calm multi-hour history video (404 Media)

free_alternative.evidence: Viewers already get unlimited **free** history videos, incl. OverSimplified (~10M subs, 2026-07) and Simple History (~5.0M).

strong_competitor.evidence: OverSimplified ~10M, Simple History ~5.0M, Kings and Generals **4.2M** subs and 1.1B views; HISTORY 15.4M.

graveyard.evidence: January 2026: 16 large AI channels removed (aggregator figure, unverified); Google's system terminated **130,000** templated AI channels in 6 months.

no_distribution.evidence: Clear: YouTube browse and suggested traffic is a real, free channel; the problem is the YPP gate, not reach. Searched vidIQ benchmarks and creator timelines.

costs_eat_margin.evidence: About **$82/month** of tools against $0 revenue until YPP; at 1,000 views a video earns ~$6 vs ~$20 tools (estimate).

weak_demand.evidence: Clear: history is a mass-market YouTube category; AI sleep-history videos draw large bedtime audiences (404 Media). No 5-year Trends data pulled.

legal_platform_risk.evidence: 100% on one platform whose **inauthentic content** rule (2025-07-15) and doubled YPP bar (2027-02-01) can end it; AI labels required.

saturated_wave.evidence: Named look-alikes: Sleepless Historian, Boring History Bites, History Before Sleep, The Snoozetorian, Dreamoria; Kapwing finds **278** AI-only trending channels.

customer.segment: US viewers of long-form history videos; the paying customer is the advertiser
customer.pain: Want calm, long, interesting history content for background or sleep
customer.today: Free human channels (OverSimplified, Kings and Generals) and AI sleep-history channels

test_plan.step: List 30 US history channels with 50k-500k subs that upload weekly and credit editors
Make 2 samples: a 3-minute AI-assisted edit and a 1,500-word script on their kind of topic
test_plan.verify: 2 samples finished in under 10 h total

test_plan.step: Send 30 personal pitches with the samples and one flat per-video price
Follow up once; offer a paid trial video
test_plan.verify: 3+ replies and 1 paid trial, or stop
